title: CropType
description: Agricultural crop types for the GAP (Southeastern Anatolia Project) region. 9-crop set; HAZELNUT removed in v2.0.0 (not grown in GAP); RICE (Çeltik) added in v2.1.0 (active GAP crop, KR-092 seasonal flight calendar scope); MAIZE renamed to CORN in v3.0.0 (MAJOR/breaking — aligns the contract canonical value with the platform CropType VO and the worker CropType enum, both of which already use CORN).

metadata.changeNote: MAJOR (breaking): crop type MAIZE renamed to CORN. Rationale: the platform CropType VO (src/core/domain/value_objects/crop_type.py) and the worker CropType enum (src/core/domain/enums.py) both already use CORN; the contract was the sole holder of MAIZE. This rename makes CORN the single canonical value across all repos and demotes MAIZE to a legacy interop alias (metadata.aliases: CORN->MAIZE). Requires migration guide: docs/migration_guides/crop_type_maize_to_corn.md. NOT renamed in this version (deferred, separate breaking tasks): (1) RED_LENTIL stays canonical (worker/platform use LENTIL) — see aliases; (2) phenology_stage.enum.v1.json MAIZE_* stage codes remain unchanged (distinct enum; consumers resolve phenology by crop_type via alias normalization, so nothing breaks). Prior v2.1.0 (MINOR): +RICE. Prior v2.0.0 (MAJOR/breaking): -HAZELNUT (Black Sea crop, not grown in GAP; migration: docs/migration_guides/crop_type_hazelnut_removal.md).

gapPriorities.description: GAP region priority crops (ALL 9 crops are GAP priorities - these are the ONLY supported crops)

aliases.description: Cross-repo / legacy name mapping. TarlaAnaliz (GAP) canonical value -> alternative/legacy names. Used only for interop translation, NOT as accepted enum values. CORN->MAIZE is a legacy alias (MAIZE was the canonical value before v3.0.0). RED_LENTIL->LENTIL is the cross-repo alias for the sibling/worker vocabulary.

archived.HAZELNUT: Removed in v2.0.0. Hazelnut (Fındık) is a Black Sea region crop and is not grown in GAP; its presence was an error. Re-adding would be a MINOR change.

notes.breaking_change_policy: Adding new crop types is non-breaking (MINOR). Removing or renaming crop types is breaking (MAJOR) and requires migration guide.
notes.gap_region: GAP (Güneydoğu Anadolu Projesi) region includes: Adıyaman, Batman, Diyarbakır, Gaziantep, Kilis, Mardin, Siirt, Şanlıurfa, Şırnak
notes.usage: This enum is used across schemas (Field, Mission, Pricing) and UI components. Always reference this canonical source.
notes.worker_alignment: As of v3.0.0 the contract, platform and worker all use CORN as the canonical maize value (MAIZE is a legacy alias only, kept for reading old payloads). RED_LENTIL remains the GAP-canonical value while the worker/platform vocabulary uses LENTIL; translate via metadata.aliases (RED_LENTIL<->LENTIL) until that rename is coordinated separately. RICE (Çeltik) is an active GAP crop within the KR-092 seasonal flight calendar scope, though the worker Stage-2 model remains blocked_by_data (KR-018 hard-gate). This GAP set is NOT 1:1 with the sibling/worker CropType, which additionally carries Aegean crops (CHERRY/FIG/APPLE/PEACH) not present here.
